labelStatus: source-derived provisional labels; not owner-validated and not gold

requiredFacts: Download records SHA-256, byte length, detected MIME and provenance.
Every target declares outputPath; overwrite and writes outside the write policy are disallowed.
Limits are 512 MiB per file, 8 files and 1 GiB per batch; the tool does not convert, unpack, execute or install.
labels.fullSupportRule: Answer all three fact groups and do not imply conversion, execution, overwrite, or unlimited support.

requiredFacts: A host observation feeds a portable MSSR transition, then Bridge adapts and emits it into bounded queue/history.
A later ordinary MCP response drains the notice for the agent.
Delivery cannot interrupt an opaque active call and is not unsolicited server push.
labels.fullSupportRule: Preserve queue/drain order and both delivery limitations.

requiredFacts: Receipt-derived C2e observations require active receipts pointing to current canonical candidates.
Explicit C2e-D claims are independent of receipts and currently limited to Bridge release/install/runtime facts.
Both channels enter the same MSSR Situation Model/C2c/C2d evaluation.
Persisted snapshots contain metadata only and exclude raw memory, prompts, transcripts, private reasoning and arbitrary document content.
labels.fullSupportRule: Distinguish receipt-derived observations from explicit claims and state metadata-only persistence boundary.

requiredFacts: Only ready recommendations may become Bridge notice actions.
Deferred recommendations remain evidence and cannot be promoted by host convenience.
A stale-context action may be shown as advisory, never automatically executed.
labels.fullSupportRule: Name the order owner, ready/deferred boundary, and nonautomatic advisory action.
